detail.longDescription: Wyze put strangers into each other's camera feeds this year. Ring keeps blurring home security into surveillance infrastructure. "Change your password" doesn't fix this, the cloud architecture itself is the vulnerability, not a toggle. Fix: open RTSP/ONVIF, VLAN isolation, local AI via Frigate. Thingino turns a $30 camera into a clean local stream, no cloud needed. https:// gaggl.com/blogs/2026-08-17-tak ing-back-the-lens/ # Privacy # OpenSource # Surveillance # DigitalSovereignty # CloudFree
